title: Stargazing in Madeira: Best Spots, Seasons and Dark Skies
description: Where to see the stars in Madeira: the best dark sky spots, the clearest seasons, what to bring and why dusk at sea is a beautiful first act. Plan your night.
heroAlt: The night sky full of stars above the mountains of Madeira
keywords: best time to see stars Madeira

images.prompt: A real-looking wide photograph of the Milky Way and thousands of stars over the dark mountain ridges of Madeira's Paul da Serra plateau at night, with a faint glow of Funchal on the horizon.
images.alt: The night sky full of stars above the mountains of Madeira

images.prompt: A photograph of the Pico do Arieiro summit ridge at dusk with the last orange light on the clouds below and the first stars appearing above.
images.alt: Dusk over the Pico do Arieiro summit with the first stars appearing

images.prompt: A photograph at dusk of a small white private motorboat on a calm sea off the Madeira coast, with the cliffs dark against a purple sky and Venus shining above.
images.alt: A small white boat on calm water at dusk off the Madeira coast
